result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.all_pairs_shortest_path_length()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Compute shortest path lengths for all pairs of nodes. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L17815-L17885){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.all_pairs_shortest_path_length() ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Uses Dijkstra's algorithm from each source node to find the shortest path distance to all other reachable nodes. For unweighted graphs, all edges are treated as having weight `1.0`. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict[int, dict[int, float]]]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Nested dictionary where `result[source][target] = distance`. Only includes reachable pairs. Unreachable pairs are omitted. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} Time complexity: `O(n * (m + n) * log(n))` where `n` is nodes and `m` is edges. Space complexity: `O(n²)` for storing all pairwise distances. For dense graphs or when you need all pairs, this is more efficient than calling `shortest_path()` repeatedly. For sparse queries, use `shortest_path()` instead. ## Examples {.doc-examples} Simple path graph: ::: {#7d1ce546 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ec.Graph() graph.add_path_graph(4) # Creates 1-2-3-4 distances = graph.all_pairs_shortest_path_length() distances[1][4], distances[2][4] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` (3.0, 2.0) ``` ::: ::: Weighted graph: ::: {#8ced2edd .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ( ec.Graph(weighted=True) .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_edge(source="A", target="B", weight=1.0) .add_edge(source="B", target="C", weight=2.0) .add_edge(source="A", target="C", weight=5.0) ) distances = graph.all_pairs_shortest_path_length() a_id = graph.get_id_from_label("A") c_id = graph.get_id_from_label("C") # A->B->C (total 3.0) is shorter than the direct A->C edge (5.0) distances[a_id][c_id] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 3.0 ``` ::: ::: Disconnected components: ::: {#ab6a64fb .cell execution_count=3} ``` {.python .cell-code} graph = ec.Graph() graph.add_path_graph(3) # 1-2-3 graph.add_node(4) # Isolated node distances = graph.all_pairs_shortest_path_length() 1 in distances, 4 in distances[1] ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=3} ``` (True, False) ``` ::: :::
